verdict.rationale: Cloud storage platforms can plausibly ship automation features, so this axis applies to Dropbox. However, the evidence pack documents no automation objects at all, and nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling them back. The deleted-file restore windows and change webhooks concern files, not automations, so they get no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
